label: sparse early-sequence feature in sequences starting with 0 (or c); no clean rule
explanation: Very sparse (0.005% of steps) and weak (max 0.23). Activations are enriched in sequences whose first token is 0 (61% of mass) or c (24%), and cluster at original steps t=3-4 and at the first copy step (recall_idx=1). It never fires at t<3 or t>10. Sequences with several digits are also over-represented. Still, no predicate gets precision above a few percent at useful recall: first_tok in {0,c} has 85% recall but 0.06% precision. The best predicate found (the sequence starts 0 0, at t=3-4) reaches dev F1 of only 0.12, and the remaining activations are spread over unrelated contexts. Magnitude is roughly uniform (median 0.12), and none of the variables tested were found to modulate it.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=0 (+3.97), orig1=0 (+3.84), prev_tok=x (+3.66), orig1=m (+2.68), orig1=i (+2.55), orig0=c (+2.55). Lower it: phase=2 (-3.34), prev3_tok=- (-2.46), to_go=5 (-0.75), orig8=- (-0.71).
